title: Your agreement at a glance
subtitle: Executive summary | Discover Southern Vietnam

items.label: Confirming your booking
items.text: Confirmation requires our written acceptance, your signature and cleared deposit or required full payment. Each adult signs separately; a parent or guardian signs for a minor. (Sections 1, 3-4, 28)

items.label: Price and room arrangements
items.text: Shared-room pricing starts at $2,875 per person and may fall to $2,500, based on fully paid enrollment 80 days before departure. Credits or refunds follow within 30 days. The $399 supplement applies only to a traveler staying alone in a room, subject to availability. Couples can share a room with a queen bed or separate beds, depending on their preference. (Section 3A)

items.label: Deposit and payments
items.text: The $500-per-person deposit counts toward your Trip Price and is nonrefundable, subject to Sections 4, 12 and 14. Pay the balance in monthly installments; full payment is due 90 days before departure. Bookings accepted within 90 days require full payment upon acceptance. Autopay is optional; no payment surcharge applies. (Sections 3A-5)

items.label: Missed payments
items.text: If you do not resolve a missed payment within seven days after written notice, we may cancel your booking and apply the cancellation charges. (Section 6)

items.label: If you cancel
items.text: Email trung@cookieparadise.co; cancellation takes effect when received. Charges per traveler: 61+ days before departure: $500; 60-31 days: the greater of $500 or 50% of Trip Price; 30-16 days: the greater of $500 or 75%; 15 days or fewer, or no-show: 100%. All payments already made, including the deposit, count toward your cancellation charge. If you have paid less than that charge, you must pay the difference. If you have paid more, the excess will be refunded within 30 days. (Section 9)

items.label: Minimum group and company cancellation
items.text: Eight fully paid travelers are required; we confirm operation by 75 days before departure. If we cancel for insufficient enrollment or another reason other than force majeure or your breach, all payments are refunded within 30 days. (Section 12)

items.label: Changes and major disruptions
items.text: Itineraries and suppliers may change. For a force majeure cancellation, you may choose a full future-trip credit or a refund less documented, unrecoverable supplier payments. (Sections 13-14)

items.label: What your package covers
items.text: Includes seven hotel nights, daily breakfast, scheduled ground transport and transfers, the listed domestic flight, and specified meals and activities. International airfare, visas, insurance, gratuities, personal expenses and optional services are excluded. See the complete lists and Appendix A.

items.label: Your responsibilities
items.text: Arrange passports, visas and international flights; provide flight details at least 30 days before departure; disclose relevant health, mobility, dietary and allergy needs; follow local laws and safety instructions. Missed or unused services generally are not refundable. (Sections 10, 15-18; Appendix C)

items.label: Travel insurance
items.text: Insurance is strongly recommended and is not included unless expressly stated. You remain responsible for applicable cancellation charges and uninsured medical, evacuation and other expenses. (Section 18A)

items.label: Travel risks and release
items.text: You accept ordinary travel risks and, where legally permitted, release the Company and specified related parties from claims caused by their ordinary negligence. Exceptions include gross negligence, reckless or intentional misconduct, fraud, express refund obligations and nonwaivable rights. Read Section 20A carefully.

items.label: Liability and claims
items.text: Certain direct economic-loss claims are capped at what you paid the Company, subject to exceptions including bodily injury or death. Report problems promptly and email claim notice within 30 days after the trip. Indiana law and the specified Indiana courts generally apply. (Sections 20B, 22, 24-25)

notice: Please read the full agreement before signing. This summary is a reading aid, does not change the agreement, and does not replace its complete terms and appendices. The full agreement and its stated order of precedence govern.
